environment.description: Same application deployed in 'userdata' namespace on the same Istio 1.19 mesh, but with PeerAuthentication set to STRICT mTLS for the namespace. An AuthorizationPolicy named 'deny-cross-ns-internal' is applied with a DENY action matching requests where source.namespace is not 'userdata' AND the path prefix is '/internal/'. A second AuthorizationPolicy 'allow-admin-ns-only' uses ALLOW action requiring source.namespace=='admin-system' for paths matching '/internal/admin/*', with a catch-all DENY for unmatched. The Envoy sidecar intercepts all inbound traffic on port 3000 before it reaches the application container. Additionally, a Sidecar resource restricts egress to only './*' and 'istio-system/*' namespaces.
